packets.name: 1-valibot-message-prefix-reference
packets.delivery:
Implemented optional `messagePrefix` support across Valibot configuration and issue generation.

Changes:
- Added `messagePrefix?: string` to the public `Config` type.
- Included `messagePrefix` in global configuration and per-parse merging, preserving an explicit per-call empty string override.
- Applied the effective prefix exactly once after custom-message precedence and callback evaluation, so callbacks receive the original message.
- Preserved nested, union, sync, async, abort, issue structure, and successful parse behavior.

Checks run:
- `npm run test:study:regression` — passed, 4/4 tests.
- `npm run test:study:feature` — passed, 4/4 tests.
- `npm run test:study:types` — completed successfully with exit code 0; the runner reported no test counters.

The supplied checks cover selected feature/regression cases and source types, not the complete upstream suite.

packets.delivery:
Implemented the nullish-key behavior for `groupBy`, `countBy`, and `indexBy`.

### Changes
- Direct and curried overloads now accept callbacks returning `K | null | undefined`.
- `null` and `undefined` keys are skipped at runtime.
- Result types contain only `K`, excluding nullish keys.
- Preserved:
  - string, number, and symbol keys
  - callback index and input-array identity
  - input immutability
  - group ordering
  - `indexBy` last-write behavior
- `indexBy` now uses a null-prototype accumulator and restores `Object.prototype`, making `__proto__`, `constructor`, and similar keys safe own data properties.
- Added focused runtime and type tests for all requested behaviors.

Commands and outcomes:

- `npm run test:study:regression` — passed, 4/4 tests
- `npm run test:study:feature` — passed, 3/3 tests
- `npm run test:study:types` — passed with no diagnostics

- Prettier check — unavailable due to missing `prettier-plugin-pkg`

Only the three implementation files and their corresponding runtime/type tests were modified.

packets.delivery:
Implemented optional predicate support for `fallback` and `fallbackAsync`.

### Changes

- `/workspace/Blame/.blame/research/confirmation-f42/campaign/2-valibot-fallback-when-cline/workspace/library/src/methods/fallback/fallback.ts`
  - Added optional synchronous predicate argument.
  - Added exported `FallbackPredicate` type.
  - Predicate receives the failed output dataset and actual parse configuration.
  - Predicate runs exactly once only when issues exist.
  - `false` preserves the original failure and skips fallback evaluation.
  - `true` or an omitted predicate preserves existing fallback behavior.

- `/workspace/Blame/.blame/research/confirmation-f42/campaign/2-valibot-fallback-when-cline/workspace/library/src/methods/fallback/fallbackAsync.ts`
  - Added optional asynchronous predicate argument.
  - Added exported `FallbackPredicateAsync` type.
  - Supports `boolean | Promise<boolean>`.
  - Awaits predicates and propagates thrown/rejected errors.

Existing two-argument calls, successful parses, schema input/output inference, and public wildcard exports remain compatible.
